title: Repeat the Directions · Pair relay
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Repeat the Directions · Pair relay with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: A partner says a sequence of three directions chosen from left, right, up and down. The lead repeats the three directions in order. All three directions match the original sequence. Form pairs. On each pair’s turn, both people make separate attempts with fresh challenges, helping only their partner. The pair earns one point only if both succeed. Each pair has two turns. Highest score wins.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 4, 6 or 8 players; materials: None.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Repeat the Directions, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
The group ends the round before anyone plays.
All three directions match the original sequence.
recall.why: All three directions match the original sequence.
